title: Rig check
info: A test song whose timing the app knows exactly. The master plays it like in a gig, every other device follows. Click and beeps should merge into one sound, the prompter lines change on the beat, the devices react in time. At the end every device asks “All good?”, the result is in the show report.

kind.label: Run
kind.info: The quick check at every soundcheck; the full run after a new setup - with tempo changes, three-four, a rest and the re-entry.
kind.quickText: Count-in, 8 bars at 120, a jump, 4 bars at 140 - track {{length}}.
kind.fullText: Every section of the test song - track {{length}}.

cues.title: Device cues
cues.info: What each device gets in the rig check - one command, sent in bar 5 (quick check) or at four places (full run). Applies to the whole band, only admins change it. A new choice takes effect at the next Prepare.
cues.none: No device with ready-made commands set up (Stage gear). The rig check then checks click, track, screens and the jump.

flow.title: Sequence
flow.info: Prepare creates the track (only the first time or after an update) and uploads it to the Stage server; the other devices then download it. Start switches the master to the test song (from Solo practice to Gig) and presses Play; afterwards the previous setlist comes back.
flow.notMaster: Only the master prepares and starts. This device follows in Gig mode.
flow.songPlaying: A song is playing - stop it first.
flow.notMasterStart: Only the master starts the rig check.
flow.notReady: Song or track haven't arrived on this device yet - one moment.

devices.title: Devices
devices.info: Every device reports itself: whether it has the track, how far its clock is from the Stage server, what it plays through and what latency is stored for that. If a device is missing, the app isn't open there or not in this band.

analysis.title: Analysis check
analysis.info: Runs the timeline editor's analysis (“Analyse track”) on the full run's test song and compares it with what the app knows: does the click grid lie on the drums in every section, and does it count the bars right? Runs on this device only, without sound.

verdict.title: Rig check: all good?
verdict.placeholder: e.g. click and beeps sounded doubled, prompter late
verdict.question: Did click and beeps sound like one, did the prompter change on the beat, did the jump come everywhere at once, and did your device react to its cue?

masterOnly: Only the master prepares the rig check.
